purpose: Whole-library source coverage support; no runtime dispatcher or acceptance certificate
scope: Frozen classes include nonfactory base/generic classes; reviewed extensions are separate; total is source rows, not supported hardware count
method: Read actual selector statements with a restricted source-expression parser, conditional on the explicitly listed family. No compiler, product consumer, fixture or device execution. nativeResolverMentionsClass is textual reference only and does not prove DMI reaches that class.
identityProjectionMeaning: Native OEM source-class relationship only. Preserve frozen identities, fan dispatch, CPU/board motion matrices and actual physical-provider admission. inputHidKey is metadata, not a VID/PID or protocol probe.

standardInput.admission: actual live source, identity, connected mask, freshness, generation and target owner; metadata alone UNKNOWN

oem.captureDisposition: selector declaration; actual producer authority/interface/epoch and key-specific native guards required

motion.availability: UNKNOWN; recipe table membership is not sensor or sample proof

physicalFeedback.selection: actual physical provider/owner, never chassis model
physicalFeedback.gameMotorAcceptance: UNKNOWN; target decoder/selector/receipt and current certification required

nativeForegroundIsolation.actualMachinePolicy: machineProfile(manufacturer, board), exact VID/PID, physical root and topology must still match
